summary: Submitted a research submission carrying sourced feedback on candidate 0a6d446a083a42cf91e99726f577eaea. It records that exploration check 6c1f4fbd37ad49e79cd922b03259d1fe settled the follower half of the narrowed discriminator: in a two-node in-process cluster with both addresses as voters and connected transports, failing every StoreLogs call on the detected follower while the leader ran a real AddVoter produced store_log_attempts 8 and store_log_failures 8 yet follower_published_phantom false, follower_servers_after equal to follower_servers_before, follower_durable_before and after both 2, and follower_last_index 2, so a follower-side durable failure neither publishes the configuration nor advances the cached last-log index because appendEntries reaches processConfigurationLogEntry only after a successful StoreLogs. The confirmed leader-side violation through direct check 3b256fe6f42b4154b75d4d2ec02e27bf (execution 452a068dbfa1488ea15bc730a0f1e7bd, correspondence no_issue_found) is retained unchanged. question_updates narrows the candidate to the one remaining discriminator: whether a StoreLogs failure that occurs after appendEntries has already deleted a conflicting log suffix leaves the follower's cached last-log index above its durable content and what that makes the follower report to a leader; that timing is backed by the in-code TODO in the captured source but is not exercised by any retained execution, so it is kept as an open sourced hypothesis rather than folded into the confirmed finding. History and versioning are preserved and resume_conditions stay empty since the candidate is escalated rather than paused. Preflight validation returned valid true. No source, evidence, credential or dependency files were modified; the draft contains submission.json.
